COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-15 commit 2b2fae6. 33 content files + 9 ADRs. Methodology v2.0. STAGES DONE THROUGH 21.5. Spine: 29 stages (21 + inserted 16.5, 18.5-18.10, 21.5).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. NOTE THE NEW THESIS DISCIPLINE SECTION.

*** STAGE 21.5 = 00z-recentering-the-map.md — THE ORIENTATION FILE. READ IT IF DIRECTION IS EVER UNCLEAR. ***
- 'Hybrid' REFINED to DISTINCTION WITHOUT UNNECESSARY SEPARATION. Not splitting differences; Scripture refuses the binaries we force onto it, BEFORE we arrive. ('Hybrid' implies two systems blended BY US.)
- ORIGINAL QUESTION RESTATED AND SPLIT IN TWO. (A) MINISTRY: does every believer possess the same calling? SUBSTANTIALLY ANSWERED NO — but bearing witness != possessing the ministry of an evangelist. (B) TIMING: what 'end', what oikoumene, what does 'this generation' control, HAS THAT PROCLAMATION ALREADY OCCURRED within the horizon Yeshua described? That is where preterism enters — AS A HYPOTHESIS BEING TESTED, NOT THE PREMISE.
- *** THESIS DISCIPLINE (now in methodology): THE BOOK MUST NOT BE 'I am a preterist, therefore here is how the Bible proves preterism.' THE PRECEDING TEXTS MUST EARN THE LITTLE-SEASON HYPOTHESIS — otherwise 'little season' becomes the lens through which every prior verse is read. CHAIN TO BE EARNED IN ORDER: preterist fulfillment -> millennial chronology -> millennium already past -> Satan presently released -> behavior derived from it. PROBABLY THE LARGEST FALSIFIABLE CHAIN IN THE PROJECT, and naming it falsifiable is the point. ***
- SAME FOR IDENTITY: text -> synthesis -> label, NEVER label -> text. 'Messianic Israelite' is shorthand at most, not a thesis, and must never become 'here's why everyone needs to call themselves this'.
- THREE FACTUAL CORRECTIONS RECORDED: (a) JUDAISM DOES CONTAIN INTERNAL MOVEMENTS — Pharisees, Sadducees, Essenes; later Rabbinic, Karaite, Hasidic, Orthodox/Conservative/Reform. (b) SEPHARDIC AND ASHKENAZI ARE NOT DENOMINATIONS — historical-cultural populations; category error to parallel with 'sects'. (c) THE TALMUD IS NOT SIMPLY 'BABYLONIAN CONFUSION' — TWO major compilations (Jerusalem/Palestinian AND Babylonian); the Oral-Torah transmission claim is a RABBINIC CLAIM whose historical establishment is a separate matter.
- THE METHODOLOGICAL ANSWER NEEDING NO HOSTILITY: TANAKH DEFINES TANAKH before later rabbinic literature — AND SYMMETRICALLY the NT is read in its first-century Jewish environment before later Christian tradition dictates it. Intertextual Priority applied to BOTH traditions.
- NEW TERMINOLOGY RULE: ANCIENT ISRAEL != THE MODERN STATE OF ISRAEL. State declared 14 MAY 1948 (user had guessed 43/45/48); Balfour Declaration 1917. Paul's Israel cannot silently become a 20th-century institution = ANACHRONISM. BRAKE BOTH WAYS: nor may we assert NO relationship to later Jewish populations — separate historical argument required either direction. Protects the argument from EITHER modern political conscription.
- NEW GLOSSARY: ANACHRONISM (ana + chronos, 'back-time') + THE ANACHRONISM TEST — before reading an ancient text through a later institution/system/model/entity/label/term, ask whether that category existed in the author's world; if not, establish ancient meaning first and argue later application separately.
- NEW RULE: 'SATAN DECEIVES' IS NOT EVIDENCE (unfalsifiability protection). Blocks: I believe X -> evidence contradicts X -> Satan is the father of lies -> therefore the contradiction proves X. Scripture establishes deception as real; individual historical claims still need evidence. PROTECTS THE INVESTIGATION PRECISELY BECAUSE IT TAKES DECEPTION WARNINGS SERIOUSLY. Companion to Point 12.
- 17-STEP ARCHITECTURE MAPPED. We did not study Sabbath because we forgot the question: Acts 15 forced Torah, Torah forced covenant, covenant forced 'who belongs' — AND WE CANNOT DETERMINE WHO RECEIVES A COMMAND UNTIL WE KNOW WHO THE COMMANDED PEOPLE ARE. LINEAR REASONING WITH BRANCHES, NOT WANDERING.
- RUPES NIGRA STAYS DOWNSTREAM. Required sequence: what Revelation SAYS -> what the camp and beloved city ARE -> ONLY THEN compare geographical models. Otherwise: find an intriguing map -> read Revelation through it -> find the map in Revelation. EXACTLY the circularity the methodology exists to prevent. If it survives the harder sequence it becomes MORE interesting.
- Babel/confusion preserved as AUTHOR'S REFLECTION, not exegetical identification.
- *** THE DESTINATION RESTATED AT THE PRECISION THE EVIDENCE SUPPORTS *** NOT 'we don't have to preach the gospel now' (too broad, unearned). RATHER: 'Does Scripture teach that the prophetic worldwide proclamation associated with the end remains an UNFINISHED COMMISSION IMPOSED UPON EVERY BELIEVER in our present historical moment?' EVEN A 'NO' WOULD NOT MEAN NOBODY SHOULD EVANGELIZE — Philip evangelizes, teachers teach, the one asked for the reason for his hope answers, parents teach children, believers bear witness in word and conduct. THE CONCLUSION WOULD BE: we must not manufacture a universal personal ministry obligation from a prophetic commission whose audience, scope and fulfillment belong elsewhere.
- IF THE LITTLE-SEASON HYPOTHESIS SURVIVES: the question changes from 'how do we finish the Great Commission?' to 'what does Scripture tell the faithful to do during Satan's little season?' Rev 20 doesn't describe saints conquering Gog and Magog by human campaign — nations deceived, saints surrounded, FIRE COMES DOWN FROM HEAVEN. But that CANNOT be assumed.

STAGE 21 = 00y-who-are-the-people-of-god.md.
- FOUR SUBSTITUTIONS REFUSED for 'the people of God' (Christians / Israel / Church replacing Israel / ethnic Israelites only).
- Begins as unmistakably ISRAELITE covenant language (Ex 6:7, Lev 26:12): 'I will be their God and they shall be My people'. PRIMARY REFERENT ISRAEL.
- But election never an end in itself: Gen 12:3 — PARTICULARITY AND UNIVERSALITY TOGETHER from the beginning; the chosen line is THE MEANS.
- TORAH ITSELF PERMITS INCORPORATION: Ex 12:48-49 'ONE LAW for the native and for the stranger'. GENEALOGY AND COVENANT MEMBERSHIP ARE RELATED BUT NOT IDENTICAL. Sixth ger appearance.
- Rahab and Ruth concrete; Ruth enters the line to David and Messiah. So 'Israel = biological ancestry and nothing else' REFUSED BY THE STORY. Opposite brake: biological Israel does NOT become irrelevant.
- *** ISAIAH 19:24-25 — YAHWEH CALLS EGYPT 'MY PEOPLE' AND ISRAEL REMAINS 'MY INHERITANCE'. EXPANSION WITHOUT ERASURE IN ONE VERSE. MAJOR CONTROL TEXT. ***
- HOSEA Lo-Ammi -> 'my people' is CONTEXTUALLY ABOUT ISRAEL — must not be skipped when Paul/Peter reuse it. FIFTH VERSIFICATION OFFSET: CJB numbers ESV Hosea 1:10 as 2:1 and 2:23 as 2:21.
- 1 Peter applies Sinai vocabulary (Ex 19) + Hosea to Messiah-followers among the nations. AUDIENCE COMPOSITION GENUINELY CONTESTED ('Dispersion' sounds Jewish; 4:3's former life sounds Gentile). Not resolved casually.
- Paul deploys Hosea in a Jew+Gentile argument (Rom 9:24-26). NOT 'because Paul doesn't care about context' — HYPOTHESIS: Israel's restoration and the nations' inclusion CONVERGE in Messiah. Needs Romans 9-11 whole.
- THE OLIVE TREE (Rom 11:17-18): wild branches grafted into an EXISTING tree; 'it is not you who support the root, but the root that supports you'. ALMOST DEVASTATING TO TRIUMPHALIST REPLACEMENT. Natural branches can be grafted in AGAIN.
- BETTER CATEGORY THAN REPLACEMENT: continuity + pruning + grafting + restoration. AVOID BOTH 'Church replaces Israel' AND 'Church simply IS Israel'. PAUL SUPPLIES GRAFTING — USE HIS VOCABULARY BEFORE INVENTING OURS.
- Ephesians 2: Gentiles were alienated FROM ISRAEL AND FROM THE COVENANTS, not merely 'not Christians'. far->near, strangers->citizens, aliens->household, two->one.
- *** MAJOR TRANSLATION DIVERGENCE — EPHESIANS 2:15 (open q 56) *** ESV: Messiah 'abolishing THE LAW of commandments expressed in ordinances'. CJB: 'destroying in his own body THE ENMITY OCCASIONED BY the Torah'. NOT THE SAME CLAIM — one removes the law, the other removes the hostility attached to it. CONTEXTUAL DATUM FAVORING THE NARROWER READING (not a lexical demonstration): v.14 has just named 'the dividing wall of HOSTILITY' and v.16 speaks of 'killing the hostility' — HOSTILITY IS THE PARAGRAPH'S RECURRING OBJECT. Interest noted both directions. FOURTH PASSAGE where an English rendering has been quoted to this project as though it were the verse (after Mark 7:19's parenthesis q29, Colossians 2:14's cheirographon q47, Hebrews 4:9's sabbatismos q50/53). THE RECURRENCE IS ITSELF A FINDING.
- THE BRAKE — Rom 11:28-29: 'beloved for the sake of their forefathers', 'THE GIFTS AND THE CALLING OF GOD ARE IRREVOCABLE'. ETHNIC ISRAEL DID NOT CEASE TO MATTER TO PAUL.
- Jeremiah 31's New Covenant is with ISRAEL AND JUDAH yet Gentiles participate — so 'Old covenant = Jews; New Covenant = Christians' is INCREASINGLY INADEQUATE. Model: Gentiles brought into covenantal blessing THROUGH ISRAEL'S MESSIAH, not given an unrelated covenant.
- Gal 3:8 calls Genesis 12 'THE GOSPEL BEFOREHAND' — GENTILE INCLUSION IS NOT A PLAN B caused by Israel's failure. But Paul does NOT say Gentiles biologically become descendants of Jacob.
- 'MESSIANIC ISRAELITE' DISCIPLINED A THIRD TIME — continue resisting a premature label; Paul's phrases are strongest (grafted in / brought near / Abraham's offspring according to promise / fellow citizens / members of Yahweh's household / one new humanity / people of God).
- STRONGEST CURRENT SYNTHESIS (Tier B): Yahweh's people remain ROOTED IN THE COVENANT STORY OF ISRAEL, CENTERED IN ISRAEL'S MESSIAH, with believing Gentiles INCORPORATED into that people THROUGH MESSIAH — rather than establishing a rival people alongside or in place of Israel.
- COUNTEREVIDENCE PRESERVED (an elegant model is exactly when to look hardest): why does Paul keep distinguishing Jew and Gentile (Acts 21:25)? which Torah obligations follow grafting? WHAT IS 'THE ISRAEL OF GOD' (Gal 6:16, open q 57 — the force of kai: 'and also upon' a DISTINCT group, or 'namely'? OPPOSITE CONCLUSIONS)? what does 'all Israel' mean (q14)? AND REVELATION 21:12-14 — TWELVE TRIBES AS GATES, TWELVE APOSTLES AS FOUNDATIONS, ONE CITY (open q 58).

TWO NEW RULES FROM STAGE 21: EXPANSION DOES NOT REQUIRE ERASURE (when Scripture extends a title/promise/blessing/identity beyond earlier recipients, do NOT assume displacement; test whether the text depicts replacement/incorporation/expansion/fulfillment/grafting; PREFER THE RELATIONSHIP EXPLICITLY SUPPLIED BY THE TEXT OVER A THEOLOGICAL LABEL IMPOSED UPON IT) and LATER INCLUSION MUST NOT REWRITE EARLIER CONTEXT (preserve the original audience FIRST, then trace the textual bridge by which Scripture itself expands scope — THIS IS THE RULE THE WHOLE PROJECT STARTED FROM).

*** THE FINDING THAT VINDICATED THE METHOD: PRESERVING ISRAEL'S PRIORITY MADE THE GENTILE CASE STRONGER, NOT WEAKER. CONTEXT DID NOT SHRINK THE GOSPEL — IT SHOWED WHY IT COULD BECOME SO LARGE. ***

*** NEXT STAGE: ROMANS 9, IN SEQUENCE *** Romans 9-11 is ONE argument routinely pulled apart to prove opposite systems. Dangerous slogans living there: 'not all who are descended from Israel belong to Israel' / 'Jacob I loved but Esau I hated' / 'mercy on whomever he wills' / 'vessels of wrath' / 'wild olive branches' / 'until the fullness of the Gentiles' / 'all Israel will be saved'. GOVERNING QUESTION — ROMANS 9:6: does Paul REDEFINE Israel as 'the Church', or make a DISTINCTION WITHIN ISRAEL concerning promise, election, and faithful remnant? GET THAT WRONG AND EVERYTHING DOWNSTREAM IS CONTAMINATED INCLUDING ROMANS 11. METHOD LOCKED: ROMANS 9 FIRST, WITHOUT LETTING ROMANS 11'S CONCLUSION PREDETERMINE WHAT ROMANS 9 IS ALLOWED TO SAY. Then see whether Paul's own argument carries us Israel -> remnant -> Gentiles -> grafting -> all Israel. IF IT DOES, THE FIRST ENORMOUS ARC OF THIS INVESTIGATION MAY BE APPROACHING ITS CLOSE.

STILL QUEUED: Stage 18 provisional verdict on clean/unclean food; sabbatismos primary-source completion (q53); Sunday (q52, dormant until a replacement is claimed).
